children: Molina Healthcare, Inc. (NYSE: MOH) today announced it will issue its earnings release for the third quarter ending September 30, 2026, after the market closes on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, and will host a conference call and webcast to discuss the earnings release on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. To access this interactive teleconference, dial (877) 883-0383 and enter the confirmation number, 6534841. A telephonic replay of the conference call will be available through Thursday, October 29, 2026, by dialing (855) 669-9658 and entering the confirmation number, 4361465.
A live broadcast of Molina Healthcare’s conference call will be available on the Company’s investor relations website,
. A 30-day online replay will be available shortly following the conclusion of the live broadcast.
